_comment: Copy to config.json (or point the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable at another path). This file holds only two entries: database and skill_dir. Everything else, such as LLM settings, lives in environment variables or in-app settings and does not go in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Pick one of two styles: (A) fill in the individual fields below, or (B) fill in only database.dsn with a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): delete database above and write a complete DSN instead. If dsn is not empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (each subdirectory is one skill and contains SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave it empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
